tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa'i tshul la/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor/ rjes spyod lam gyi yan lag go /dang po la gsum las/ sgrib pa sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la/ chos la/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o/ /rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ las thim/ de 'od du zhu yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbacom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs lus thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas rkang pa'i mthe bong nas 'dzags par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha dṛ dho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyoo me bha wa/ sarb+ba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karm+ma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan/ he ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci nus su bzlas nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pas te/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa ltung ba grib ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo/ gnyis pa rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po can du gyur/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs shing / 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa spyan drangs la phyag 'tshal bar mos la/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /ces brjod do/ /dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing / oṃ bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra ni ri te hūm̐ khaṃ/ ni wi te hūm̐ khaṃ/ sarb+ba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ mahā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra gan dhe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra ni wi tyai āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badzra shapda āḥhūm̐ swā hās dbul/ rang gi yid kyis sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis bdud rtsi lnga/ grub pa'i dngul chu cang te'u'i sgra/ 'khyud pa'i bde bas mchod par mos la/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /lha mo brgyad po rnams kyis mchod/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan pa 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing / /pukka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes te/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan cing / /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje bsgrubs pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pas bstod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don gyi rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod pas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni gzung nas su/ /ji srid snying po byang chub bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/

/byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma rgal ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig chags sdang nye ring gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ gis chos thams cad rnam thar sgo bzhi'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /gsum pa bar chad bsrung ba'i don du srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ zhu ba las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du bhūm̐ ser po zhu ba las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba khog pa stong pa rtsibs bcu dang ldan pa go skabs med pa kha dog ser po/ oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐/ gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du bhrūm̐ ser po/ phyogs bcu'i nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ de'ang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/

de rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje gshed tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad ma mthar byed dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ /hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad g.yas pa phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba dang / shes rab mthar byed dang pad ma mthar byed ma gtogs pa gzhan thams cad sngon po/ phyogs bzhi dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams rab tu khros pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ mtshams kyi khro bo rnams cung zad zhi ba/ skra nag po can rin po ches brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' mnabs pa/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ badzra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥse gol gdab/ ni ri te hūm̐ kham̐ nas shapda'i bar gyis sngar bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas rigs lnga spyan drangs/ snga ma ltar mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ gyis gsol ba btab pas/

bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas gshin rje gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ pad ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ yang rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lus thams cad la khyab pas rdo rje gtams pa'i go gyon/ yang rang gi snying kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ zhu ba las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i nang du rang gi shes pa hūm̐ sngon por gyur pa'i steng du bla ma/ g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yogs/ 'og tu nor rdzas la sogs pa'i bsrung bya rnams dmigs te/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ khro bo rnams la phog pas rgyud bskul/ bdag bsrung ba'i don du sngags 'don/ 'khor lo la phogs pas g.yas skor du myur du 'khor bas dgra bgegs phye mar byas par bsgom zhing / na maḥs manta bud dhā nāṃ/ na maḥs manta dharmā nāṃ/ na maḥs manta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tra/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra tyaṃ gi ra/ oṃ badzra uṣṇi ṣa tsakra warti sarb+ba yant+ra mant+ra/ mū la karma/ ban dha naṃ/ tā ḍa naṃ/ kī la nan bā/ ma ma kṛ te/ ye na ke na tsitta kṛta tan tad sarbantu/ tshin da tshin da/ bhin da bhin da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ces pa dang / oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ trā sa naṃ/ sarb+ba mā ra/ pra tyaṃ gi ra/ bi nā sa ni/ ye ke tsita duṣṭan satwa ma ma bi rū pa kaṃ/ kur ban ti tā ni/ sarb+ba ṇi pra tyaṃ kā ri ṇi/ pa ta tu hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ ces ci nus bzlas te/ gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / sems can thams cad la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa dang /

sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe/ de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig de'i 'go ba'i lha de nyid kyis de'i sha la za bar gyur cig sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa de'i 'bras bu de nyid la 'byung bar gyur cig khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs bsgral nas rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas par bsam mo/ /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ srung 'khor brtan par byas par bsams te/ de rnams ni dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor la rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi dang po la drug las/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ni/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ gzhi'i yan lag e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du rgyu'i yan lag yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu changs zungs dang mchog ma la yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pa la as mtshan pas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pa dang lte ba la laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu drug pa bhrūm̐ gyiis mtshan pa bsam/

de lnga rkyen gyi yan lag rang gi sems oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa dang gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim bzhin du nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shu yod pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa ba'i stegs bu 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i thad so bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis brteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang / gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang par gyur pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang na tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu rgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi bzad pa/ nub byang du kī li kī li'i sgra sgrogs pa'i dur khrod de/ de'i nang na phyogs skyong brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje gshed sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa dbyug to 'dzin pa/

byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang dbyug gu gsum pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon shwa ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad kyang rgyan gyis brgyan zhing rang 'dra'i rig mas g.yon nas bsten pa la lag pa g.yon pas 'khyud cing / spyi bos bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ shing chen po brgyad ni/ shi ri sha/ tsū ta/ kaṃ ka la/ a shwad tha/ shing chen po/ ka rañdza/ 'khril shing can/ ardzun rnams so/ /de rnams la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad ni/ shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can/ nub tu sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong pa can/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du yi dwags 'dus pa dud kha glang gi gdong pa can/ shar lhor drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu srin po'i tshogs can nag po ro langs kyi gdong pa can/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon shwa ba'i gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb nas lus phyed 'thon pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /klu chen po brgyad ni shar du nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad ma dkar po/ nub tu kar ko ṭa nag po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ byang shar du pad ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor hu lun ta sngon po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang gu nub byang du dung skyong ser po rnams sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka dang ldan zhing sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /sprin chen po brgyad ni/ shar du sgrog byed ser po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/

nub tu 'jigs pa dkar po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ byang shar du mthug po dkar po/ shar lhor 'gengs byed dmar po/ lho nub tu char 'bebs nag po/ nub byang du gtum po ljang gu rnams so/ /gzhan yang mchod rten brgyad/ chu bo brgyad/ me brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang ba/ ro dang ro langs dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang sha za'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag bzangs ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan bsam mo/ /de nas gzhal yas khang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor mos te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī lā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de nga rgyal gzung ngo / /gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo shel gyi phreng ba lta bu'i a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa ā lis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa kā lis mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa so sor kun tu rtogs pa'i ye shes/

de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ kye rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka rgyab kyi zhal bzhi gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i/ g.yas dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na shar bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la'ang mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum pa skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/

gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ dga' ba bzhi'i 'byung gnas su mos te/ oṃ padma su kha dha ra/ mahā rā ga su khanda da/ tsa tu ra ā nan dā bhāka wi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ kāryaṃ ku ru ṣwa me/ oṃ badzra mahā dwāe ṣa/ tsa tu ra ā nanda dā ya ka kha ga mu kha/ e ka ra so/ nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ kāryaṃ ku ru ṣwa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kun dhu ru badzra dhṛka ces pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i me 'od du zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar 'babs/ thig le brgyad du gyur/ de rnams/ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐/ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ gi sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de 'od du zhu/ lha mo brgyad du gyur nas/ yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 'thon te gdan so so'i steng du rim pa bzhin 'khod pa ni/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar po g.yas ḍa ma ru g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai tā lī ser mo g.yas ru sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pukka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon mkhar gsil 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan zhing /

skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms pas rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin thig ler gyur par mos te/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung / de nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i don du/ pukka sī la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas rim pa bzhin glus bskul bar bsams te/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /pukka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzad/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la zhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag ni dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces brjod pas thig le de hūm̐ am̐ sngon po 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka/ rgyab zhal bzhi gnag pa/ gzhan me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sngar bzhin bskyed/ lha bcu'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i sa bon/ hūm̐/ am̐/ gam̐/ tsam̐/ bam̐/ gham̐/ pam̐/ sham̐/ lam̐/ ḍam̐/ rnams las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang / bcud kyi sems can la phog lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ thams cad kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/

rna bar ḍam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar sam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying kar nam̐ las bdag med ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mgo bo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs par mos la/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzas se gol gdab/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ rang gi snying ka nas gau rī lcags kyu thogs pa spros/ lcags kyus ye shes pa rnams kyi thugs kar reg pas gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du byon/ tsau rī zhags pa thogs pa spros/ mgrin par zhags pas reg pas bdag la thim/ bai tā lī lcags sgrog thogs pa spros/ zhabs la lcags sgrog gis reg pas bdag la mnyes bzhin du mi 'bral bar gyur/ ghasma ri dril bu thogs pa spro/ dril bu'i sgras bskul te bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la g.yas pa'i mdzub mos mdud pas lcags kyu dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi rgyab kyi rtse sprad de mig dang ldan par byas pa zhags pa dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung gnyis dang mdzub mo gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel ba lcags sgrogs dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad nas mnyams te mnan pa 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra gau rī ā kar ṣa ya dzaḥ

tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ bai tā lī bandha baṃ/ ghasma rī ba shyṃ ku ru hoḥzhes brjod do/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ni/ de nas rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu spyan drangs par mos/ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥs se gol gdab/ sngar bzhan mchod pa'i rjes su/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rigs lngas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'/ི /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu dbyangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo bcus bgegs bskrad/ lha mo drug gis mchod nas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang / /lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /dbang gi chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang /

ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo las kyi phyag rgya/ snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo phyag rgya chen po zhes brjod cing dran par bya'o/ /chu rgyun des snying kha yan chad gang / yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna ma zhes bshad/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes brjod cing dran par bya/ /chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag mar yar lud pas/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau rī dang pukka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā lī dang tsaṇḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang ḍoṃ bi nī la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid du mos te/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ni/ nang mchod/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod pas bgegs bsal/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarb+ba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud dho haṃ/ zhes pas dri ma sbyangs nas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed po gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po/ yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/

dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bhrūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rakta/ nub tu dzriṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaṃ las klad pa/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du/ bhrūm̐/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dzriṃ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de'i mthar g.yon skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge lnga dang bcas pa zhu/ rlangs pa dang oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags pa thod par lhung ba'i rlangs pa dang / hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bkug la/ rdo rje la thim/ rdo rje nyi ma dang oṃ dang hūm̐ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas rdzas rnams zhu ste kha dog dang / ro dang / dri dang / nus pa phun sum tshogs par bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dang / ha ho hriḥzhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lan gsum dkrugs la dbus nas blangs te gtor zhing mchod do/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du yab yum dang lha mo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la phul bas lha thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes par mos la/

oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung ngo / /lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ni/ lha mo brgyad kyis rang nyid la sngar bzhin mchod par mos la/ dkar mo ri dwags kyi rjes su bdag nyid la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi don grub kyi ngo bo mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod par mos te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung ngo / /drug pa bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni/ lha mo de rnams kyis bdag la mgrin gcig tu bstod par mos te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyi rjes su/ bdag nyid la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rin 'byung gi ngo bo bstod pa sna tshogs kyis bstod par mos te/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta tūsti ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung la/ lha dang gzhal yas khang snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon 'dra ba la dmigs pa gtad la yid mnyam par gzhag go /gnyis pa brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la rlung ro bsal te/ lus kyi dbus kyi spyi gtsug nas lte ba'i bar la/ rtsa dbu ma phra zhing gsal ba thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo raktas gang ba/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo khu bas gang ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su a/ nang skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ phyi'i 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la g.yon skor du ā li phrag gnyis/ g.yas skor du/ ha dang kṣa spangs pa'i kā li so gnyis thams cad kyang mdog dmar po mgo gyen la lta ba/ snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar hūm̐/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas brtsams pa'i phyogs bzhir/ bhruṃ/ aṃ/ dzriṃ/ khaṃ/ me nas brtsams te mtshams bzhir/ lāṃ/ māṃ/ pāṃ/ tāṃ/ rnams mdog sngon po mgo 'thur du blta ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ/

'dab ma bcu drug la g.yon skor du/ ā li phrag bcu drug mdog dmar po gyen bstan/ spyi bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i lte bar haṃ/ 'dab ma so gnyis la g.yon skor du ā li phrag gnyis thams cad mdog dkar po mgo thur du blta ba dmigs nas 'og sgo 'byed 'dzums kyi sbyor bas 'og gi rlung g.yos pas lte ba'i a las me byung / g.yas ro ma'i me dang 'grogs te gyen du 'bar bas/ snying mgrin gyi 'khor lo bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ las byang sems kyi rgyun g.yon rkyang ma'i thig le dang sdongs nas bab pas mgrin snying gi 'khor lo gsal btab/ thigs pa gcig lte ba'i a la phog pas a las me shin tu phra ba dbu ma nas yar song pas snying ka'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bcom/ spyi bo'i haṃ la bsnun pas haṃ las thig le'i rgyun dbu ma nas babs/ oṃ dang hūm̐ gsal btab nas/ lto snying gi dbus su me dang thig le ro gcig tu 'dres pa las dkar dmar gyi rnam par gnas pa la yid rtse gcig tu gtad de/ rlung kha sbyar nas gsal stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag go /gsum pa rjes spyod lam gyi yan lag la brgyad las/ dag pa dran pa ni/ rdzogs rim las langs nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor wal dran par byas la/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs la yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug bskyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum po/ /sha ni pukka sī ru brjod/ /de bzhin khrag ni ri khrod ma/ /gdol pa mo ni khu bar brjod/ /g.yung mo rkang dang tshil bu dag /pags pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rus pa bden pa bzhi po nyid/ /ces brjod cing don dran par bya'o/

gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐/ am̐/ gam̐/ tsam̐/ bam̐/ gham̐/ pam̐/ sham̐/ lam̐/ ḍam̐ rnams dmigs nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags bzlas pa'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng dmar po lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu 'phros/ rang gi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i am̐ la thim/ mkha' las 'thon/ yab kyi gsang nas nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de ltar 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskul nas/ bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags zlo ba'i tshe/ rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'khor bar bsam zhing / zlo ba'i tshe rang gi zhal brgyad dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu brjod par bsam zhing bzla'o/ /sngags ni oṃ aṣṭā na nā ya/ pi gordha ke sha wartam ne/ tsa tu ra biṃ sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la a ne ka dhā ri ṇe/ adhmā ta kru ra tsittā ya/ ar dhendu daṃṣṭ+rī ṇe/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sapta sā ga ran/ bandha bandha/ nā ga aṣṭa kān/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sha trun/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa ni rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐phaṭ swāhā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra karta ri he badzrā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ nye snying ngo / /oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yum gyi phreng sngags so/ /oṃ āḥnam̐ badzra nai rātma hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yum gyi mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ āḥgam̐ badzra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ badzra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/

oṃ ā tsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ badzra bai tā lī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ badzra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgham̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ badzra pukka sī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥpam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ badzra sha ba ri hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ badzra tsaṇḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ badzra ḍoṃ bi ni hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ de rnams ni lha mo brgyad kyi mtshan sngags dang sa bon gyi sngags so/ /gsum pa mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par bye ste/ 'og gi bya ba rnams byed par bsams la/ mdun du bshams pa'i mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang zhing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par mos la/ ooṃ badzra ni ri te hūm̐ khaṃ la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun gyi ras bris sam me tog tshom bu la sogs pa sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ gur/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i dbus su 'byung ba bzhi dang 'khor lo rang gi sems ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa nas rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi bar sngar bzhin bskyed nas/

de'i phyi rol du dur khrood brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ nas/ nub byang du thag bzang sa ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing / gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i bar sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du shrī he badzrā ya na maḥ kye rdo rje dang / nam̐ badzra nai rād ma ya na maḥ bdag med dang / gam̐ badzra gau rī ye na maḥ gau rī/ tsam̐ badzra tsau rī ye na maḥ tsau rī/ bam̐ badzra bai tā lī na maḥ bai tā li/ ghaṃ badzra ghasma rī na maḥ ghasma rī/ paṃ badzra pukka sī na maḥ pukka sī/ shaṃ badzra sha ba rī na maḥ sha ba rī/ laṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī na maḥ tsaṇḍa lī/ ḍaṃ badzra ḍoṃ bi nī na maḥ ḍoṃ bi nī/ rnams skad cig gis bskyed la/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams gong ltar gsal gdab/ de rnams kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ dpral bar sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ sku mdog phyag mtshan yid kyis gsal btab/ oṃ e hye hi/ la sogs pas spyan drangs nas sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ gau rī ā kar ṣa ya dzaḥl sogs pas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ rigs lnga spyan drangs par mos la/ ni ri te la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas/ badzra wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis dbang bskur nas/ sku thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las dbur brgyan pa'i bar sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ badzra sa mā dzas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la se gol gdab cing / rdo rje thal mo snying kar sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/

/lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces dang / pad kor byas la/ oṃ bha ga wā na mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi gung mo rtsa sprad pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badzra ni ri te hūm̐ khaṃ dang lag pa bsnol te se gol gdab cing swāhā/ zhes brjod pas zhabs bsil/ de bzhin du sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes la badzra nai wi dye hūm̐ khaṃ gis zhal bsil/ sarb+ba saṃ sho dha nis 'thor 'thung / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mahā arghaṃ pra tītstshas mchod yon/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo gnyis kha thur du bstan nas 'og nas drangs te steng du rdo rje khu tshur byas pa gyen du 'thor ba'i tshul byas la/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog de bzhin du/ tshal bdag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo steng nas 'og tu bskos te/ rdo rje khu tshur bcings la/ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo 'og nas steng du bskor te mthe bong gnyis bshibs nas brkyang pa bskor ba'i tshul dang / badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skyes gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /thal mo steng nas 'og tu bskor te/ snying kar rdo rje khu tshur rgyab bstan pa bcas nas gyen du brkyang ste slar yang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas spyi bor bzung la/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi ger 'ong /

/sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo gyen du bstan te gzhag pa zhal zas 'bul ba'i phyag rgya dang / badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra shapda āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ dang / a las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang padma 'dab ma lnga pa hūm̐ dang as mtshan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badzra mahā badzra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje blangs te smin mtshams kyi thad kar lan gsum gsor hūm̐ zhes brjod de snying kar bzung nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bor mos la/ badzra ghaṇḍa a/ zhes brjod cing / g.yon pas dril bu blangs te/ dkur bzung la a zhes brjod do/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i stong pa nyid ston pa'i gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i ngo bor mos/ rang he ru kar dmigs la/ lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig dran par byas la/ dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol zhing / oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarb+ba buddha kṣe tra ppar tsā li ne/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da swa bhā we/ badzra dharmā hṛ da ya san to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ mchod pa phul ba'i tshe rang gi snying ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas de dang / de thogs pa dang dpag tu med pa byung nas/ dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsams te/ phyi'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas nang mchod bdud rtsi myang ba'i skabs ltar mtheb srin gyis smin mtshams kyi thad kar phul la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/

brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a ba dhū tī pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung pa/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che/ bla ma dam pa zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje na bza' brag phug pa/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ ru sbal zhabs/ shrī dzā lan dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu hya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs can/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ glog skya shes rab rtsegs/ mal gyo blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po la sogs pa dang / rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrāddhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal gyi blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po la sogs/ rdo rje 'chang / slob dpon klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gupta/ rin chen rdo rje/ ratna kīrti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsa ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po la sogs/ rgyud sde bzhi sde snod gsum dang 'brel ba'i dbang rgyud man ngag gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi/ dkon mchog gsum/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu khyad par can rnams kyi/ kye rdor bde mchog la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas bya ba spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/

de nas rang gi lus kyi lha mchod pa'i phyir lce rtse/ smin mtshams spyi bor gtor zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de nas chos skyong che chung gnyis dang / sgos kyi chos skyong gang byed kyi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang / gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong ba'i bka' sdod srung ma rnams kyi zhal du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro/ gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'gro ba sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ bya rgod phung po'i ri/ nā land+ra/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten/ go ma sa la'i mchog rten/ gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten/ shar phyogs ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri/ nub phyogs o rgyan/ byang shaṃ bha la/ 'phags pa shing kun la sogs pa/ rgya gar/ rgya nag li yul bal po la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can gyi rten dang / gtsug lag khang gi srung ma rnams kyi/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa/ lha sa/ skar chung / mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul la sogs pa bod kyi gtsug lag khang gi srung ma rnams kyi/ mu gu lung / dge chu/ mkhar chung / sag thag sdings/ gnas gsar/ skya bo kha gdangs/ kha'u skyed lhas/ g.yu 'khar mo/ dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas la sogs pa bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can na gnas pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang /

gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig thams cad kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la phul te/ nang gi mchod pa'o/ de nas sngar bzhin/ dkar mo ri dwags la sogs pa brjod de/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs la sogs pa'i rjes su/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kye yi rdo rje bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo dang steng nag po mdzes/ dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag pa'i zhal rnams ni/ /gnag pa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mo/ /skyes pa khyi dang ma he can/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'/ི /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid 'jigs/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lnga yis yang dag brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor mdzes/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gam̐ las skyes pa'i gau rī shar/ /yan lag gnag cing g.yon na nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs ba mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/

/tsam̐ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bam̐ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /g.yon na lhung bzed g.yas pa na/ /ru sbal bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang gu gham̐ las byung ba yi/ /phyag ni sbrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan cing pam̐ las byung / /g.yon na dgra sta seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal pukka sī sngo la/ /ri khrod ma dkar sham̐ las byung / /me ru nor sbyin steng nas mnan/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i ngo bsangs ma/ /srin por lam̐ las byung ba yi/ /g.yon pas thong pa 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po nyid la 'o/ /ḍam̐ las skyes pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzangs rigs steng gshegs/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams ni rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster ni thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid kyis 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa/ /zhi ba'i bde rtsol rig mar bsdud mdzad pa/ /shes rab chags pas bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje/

/lha mo'i 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten der mtshungs shog /ces brjod pa bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtse'am mtheb srin gyis gtor ma la nang mchod nas gtor la/ gtor ma sngar ltar bsang sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang du pad ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs kyi steng gi lte ba dang 'dab ma'i oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug byang shar du bhṛṃ gi ri ti/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du gzhon du kār ti ka thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ bar gyi lte bar sngar gyi lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor 'dab ma'i hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'og gi pad ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma'i āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ byang shar du pad ma chen po/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad ma/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ pad ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la mnyam par sbyor ba kun kyang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

sku rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la bsdus/ kye rdo rje thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sa steng gi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la bsdus/ gsung rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sa 'og gi sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la bsdus par mos te/ sa steng sa bla sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ phyag rgya bca'/ mdun bskyed ltar skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ni ri te la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ e hye hi/ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra kā ya wā ka tsitta sa pa ri wā ra gau rī ā kar ṣa ya dzaḥl sogs pas dam tshig pa la bstim/ mdun bskyed ltar dbang bskur bas/ steng ma rnams la rnam snang / bar ma rnams la mi bskyod pa/ 'og ma rnams la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ de nas lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i dbus ma nas 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ e hye hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra/ kā ya wā ka tsitta/ ind+ra/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzakkha/ bhū ta/ ba hni/ bā u/ rakkha/ tsanda/ pudzdza/ mā da/ pappa/ tā la/ pa tā la/ aṣṭha sappa swāhā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ gha/ phulla/ dhuppa/ māṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ amba/ sappa kādzdza/ sā dha/ khinti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarb+ba dharmā ṇaṃ ādya nutpanna twād ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ ni ri te la sogs pas mchod/ kā ya wā ka tsitta oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod gtor/ dkar mo ri dwags la sogs pa dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyi rjes su/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/

/rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /rjod byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la gsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrung / /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma can/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang /

/bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol/ kolla i retṭha a bo lā/ mummu ṇi re kakko la/ gha ṇe ki piṭṭa ho badzdza i/ ka ru ṇi ki a i ṇa ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādzdza ī/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidzdza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ du dhū ra bidzdza a i/ tsa u sa ma katstshu ri sihla/ kappu ra lā i a i/ mā la i in dha ṇa sā li ñdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā -i a i/ phrai ཾkha ṇa khe ṭa ka ranta/ shud dha a shud dha ṇṇa ma ni a i/ ni raṃ su aṃ ga tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun dhu ru waṭṭa i/ ḍiṇḍi ma ta hi ṇṇa b-idzdza a i/ zhes pas rdo rje'i glu blang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa 'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan chos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa 'o/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsams pa dang / /gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang / /bden par smra ba rnams kyi bde legs shog /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang / /rgyud ni nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang / /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pas te/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang /

/'dod pa grub cing phun sum tshogs pas te/ /bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi/ /lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /mnyam par 'jog cing shes rab bskyed pa ste/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir gsol/ /zhes pas bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gis lam gyis 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pas smon lam gdab bo/ /de nas 'das gtor gnyis pa yod na bde mchog la 'bul zhing / gtor ma gsum pa la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan par gyur/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang / sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gyur/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te ho zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du paṃ las pad ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar gcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du traṃ la e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bhyo las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/

sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bhyo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drangs par mos la/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas te/ mdzub mo g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya e hye hi zhes dang / rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba lha mo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya g.yab pa'am dril bu'i sgras/ lha mo 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /zhes sogs dang / mahā kā li de wyai e hye his spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ pad ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis pad ma'i gdan dbul/ ooṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wyai gṛhṇa daṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ pā dyaṃ swāhā/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shapda'i bar gyis mchod/ so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la spyi bor rdo rje gzhag par mos te/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wa ye/ sa ma ye sma ra ye/ sa ma ye mā ti kra ma ye/ sa ma ye rakṣantu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/

khyad par du bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing spa bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi/ bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces phrin las gzhol/ sngar bzhin gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsams/ la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wa ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swāhā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ gong ltar mchod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣā pashtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ/ ratna tra ya a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tidzña sma ra si ta da/ i daṃ duṣṭa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ ban dha ban dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ ces gzungs ring dang / oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ mgon po'i snying po dang / oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣṭa wa to si kā ma la rakṣa si hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes lha mo'i snying pos nang mchod gtor/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ rnga brdung zhing / hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum rtsegs 'jig byed pa'i/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/

/thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ /khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /zhes pas bstod/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā lā ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po mahā kā lā ya/ /'jigs byed chen po mahā kā lā ya/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum rtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra bla nag po che/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying 'byin nag po che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da 'chol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du bsgrubs/ /zhes dang / bhyoḥ gang gis sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zal mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku/ /ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid/ /dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs/ /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas spras/ /klu dbang seng ge lcags sgrog dang / /khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/

/bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu/ /shin tu rid cing mi gdug ma/ /'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug sdong ldir ba'i sgra sgrogs pas/ /khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ /khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/ /khro dang 'khrug dang rngam pa yis/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi la sogs kyis bstod cing phrin las gzhol lo/ /de nas gtor ma bzhi pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun du paṃ las pad ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las gtso 'khor lnga dus gcig tu bskyed de/ dbus su nag po chen po zhal bzhi g.yas brtsegs ma gnyis sngon po/ g.yon brtsegs ma gnyis ljang gu/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po gri gug g.yon dang po thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin zhing / g.yas 'og ma ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas mi rus kyi phreng ba phyar thabs su bsnams shing bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du thogs pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskum zhing / g.yon brkyang bas bzhengs pa/ sku mdog nag po/ dbu skra kham pa gyen la 'bar ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa'i ma mchu 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ tshangs pa'i skud pas se ral kha byas pa/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ gi gad rgyangs sgrogs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar nag rgyab tu sing ga li ser nag thams cad gcer mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag gtso bo la stob pa/

khro mo'i cha lugs can lnga ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrood nas ye shes spyan drangs par mos la/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra ṭi ta/ ḍoṃ bi ni/ tsaṇḍa li/ rakkha si/ sing ka li de wi/ sa pa ri wa ra e hye his spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ padma ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan dbul/ sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor gzhag par mos la/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra ṭ-i ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ ḍoṃ bi ni/ tsaṇḍa li/ rakkhu si/ siṅga li/ de wi/ sa ma ye sma ra ye nas phrin las gzhol ba'i bar dang / de wi'i rjes su/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te la sogs pa btags la sngar bzhin gtor ma dbul/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de wi'i rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la phud kyis mchod/ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang sgyur zhing / /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gzhon nu'i lus can bgegs 'joms khyod la 'dud/ /du ma'i ming can drag po'i phreng ba can/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i mig gis bdud 'joms shing / /brkyang bskum glog stong 'gyu ba'i khro gnyer can/ mdung thung gri gug bum thod 'dzin la bstod/ /'jigs byed myur 'gro tshangs skud mi mgo yi/ /phreng ba 'dzin cing sa gsum bskrag byed pa/ /kṣiṃ kṣiṃ sgra sgrogs srin po'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin chen po nas/

/khyod bzhugs ti se'i gangs ri la/ /gdong bzhi ldan khyod zhing skyong mdzad/ /kun srung khyod la bstod par bya/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrogs pa'i dpal khyod kyis/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i bgegs rnams kun/ /skrag mdzad khyod la bstod par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/ /dam bcas don 'di da lta 'dir/ /sgrub la thogs pa med gyur pa'i/ /dam tshig ldan khyod bstod par bya/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag la dga' ba/ /khyod ni byang na rab bzhugs shing / /phyogs bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang / /sing ga la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar dang ljang nag khros pa'i zhal/ /gri gug thod 'dzin bstod par bya/ /khyod kyis rang phyogs legs bsrung zhing / /gzhan phyogs rnam par sun 'byin po/ /don gnyis sgrub pa'i yab yum la/ /bdag gis rtag tu bstod par bya/ /de ltar bstod pas rab bsngags pas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /'dod pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang / /bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzod/ /khyod kyi sgrub po'i las bya zhing / /rjes su bsgrubs na brtse ba dang / /yongs su brten na dgyes pa dang / /sun 'byin rnam par gzhom par mdzod/ /klog pa rnams ni rgyas pa dang / /kha don phun sum tshogs pa dang / /sgrub pa dri ma med pa yi/ /bstan pa dag kyang dar bar mdzod/ mdor na gang dang gang bcol ba/ /de dang de yi las rnams la/ /btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /bdag la rjes su brtse bar mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/ /de nas gtor ma lnga pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs sngar ltar byin gyis brlab/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ phaiṃ oṃ badzra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ dṛ shyā hoḥs spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/

un mā da/ a pasma ra/ ḍā ki n+yā da yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa tu sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha du/ ya the baṃ/ ya theṃṣṭa/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gra tha/ pi wa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sat+sa khaṃ/ bi shud dhya sahā yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ mchod pas mchod la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sogs nas sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod gtor la/ bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtor ma drug pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bskyed/ a kā ros dbul/ slar yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phud gtor la/ gtor ma 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ /mchod do/ mgron no/ /sbyin no/ /gsol lo'i rjes su bstan pa dar sogs gong ltar brjod/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pas nongs pa bshags/ sngar ltar smon lam gdab bo/ /bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phud bla ma yi dam chos skyong la dbul/ rang he ru kar dran pa'i lag pa g.yas dgang gzar/ g.yon blugs gzar/ kha thab khung / lte ba nas 'bar ba'i gtum mo'i mes lus thams cad gang ba'i snying kar bla ma dang yi dam/ lte bar chos skyong dang 'jig rten pa'i lha/ bza' btung bsreg rdzas su mos nas lha mchod pa'i bsam pas ma chags par longs spyod/ lhag ma la 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas chang gi kha phru btab ste/ oṃ u tsiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swāhās/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas sngar bzhin rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/

rdo rje thal mo snying kar sbyar te/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /kye yi rdo rje 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus par/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /ces pa'i rjes su sngar gyi smon lam gdab/ mdun gyi lha la phyi nang yid byung bstod pa'i mchod pas sngar bzhin mchod la/ sngar gyi bzod gsol gyi rjes su/ khyod kyis sems can gyi khams la rjes su brtse bas bka' stsal zhing dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs te/ sems can gyi don mdzad na so so skye bo rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pa rnams brjed nges pa'am/ yo byad ma tshang ba la sogs pa nyes pa gang cung zad bgyis pa de dag bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yod na/ ji srid du 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig pa de srid du ye shes pa rnams 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhās brtan par bzhugs la/ rten med pa'am gshegs gsol dgos pa ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badzra muḥzhes pa ye shes pa dang gtor mgron rnams la dngos grub blang zhing gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ 'das gtor gcig bar chad bsrung ba'i don du gzhag la/ gtor ma gzhan rol mo dang bcas pas sa gtsang sar khyer la/ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang / /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/

/mkha' lding bya khyi lce spyang 'khor dang bcas/ /pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs kyi rjes su/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam kun/ /dpal 'byor gyi rgyun yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces pas btab cing btang / nang du 'ongs te skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la bsrung / ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi mchog rab lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /gis bkra shis brjod do/ /lnga pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ srod kyi bya ba rnams tshar nas gnyid log pa'i tshe/ rang gtso bo la thim/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud srung 'khor la/ de gzhal yas khang / de lha so so/ de zhal la ste/ bai tā lī steng zhal la/ yum yab la/ yab hūm̐ la thim ste/ mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ /drug pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni hūm̐ zhes brjod pas stong pa las kye rdo rje'i skur bzhengs te hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lha dang gzhal yas khang snod bcud rnams dmigs nas/

gzugs sku snod bcud phrin las 'jug pa'i yul du mos pas ldang ngo / /bdun pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dbang bskur dang 'dra ba las khyad par dbang bskur bas/ phyi nang gi dri ma dag lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsams te yig brgya brjod cing khrus bya/ dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol/ brgyad pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ mnyam gzhag las langs pa'i dus kun tu lha mo brgyad zhal la/ yum yab la/ yab phyag gnyis par bsdus nas gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung / skye mched drug gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug gzugs gau rī/ sgra tsau rī/ dri bai tā lī/ ro ghasma rī/ reg sa spyod/ chos kyi skye mched mkha' spyod/ snang ba lha/ grag pa sngags/ sems kyi 'gyu ba ting nge 'dzin du bsams la/ zung 'jug gi ngang la lhas lha mchod pa'i bsam pas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyad cing / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i spyod lam rnam bzhis ci bder spyad do/ /tshul 'di lta bus dus rtag tu gnas na/ thun mong mchog gi dngos grub myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /tshul 'di 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung 'ga' re dang mi mthun pa yod kyang / rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa dag gi bzhed pa dang phyag len ji lta ba bzhin yin pas/ khungs btsun par khong du chud par bya'o/ /'di ni las dang po pa dag gis go sla ba'i don du/ btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos khrigs su sdebs pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig shubhaṃ// //maṅga laṃ bha wantu// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 40 bla ma dam pa/ kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 41
